articles.title: Swan Bitcoin sued for nearly $1B over pre-bankruptcy transfers from Prime Trust
articles.snippet: Swan Bitcoin has been sued for allegedly using insider access to pull nearly $1 billion in Bitcoin and cash from Prime Trust days before its 2023 bankruptcy filing.

articles.title: Galaxy secures New York BitLicense to expand institutional crypto services
articles.snippet: The NYDFS approvals allow GalaxyOne Prime NY to offer trading and financing services to institutional investors in one of the most tightly regulated US crypto markets.

articles.title: Swan Bitcoin Hit With Nearly $1 Billion Lawsuit Over Prime Trust Collapse
articles.snippet: The lawsuit alleges that the Bitcoin-centric financial services firm took advantage of insider information to escape major losses.
